dataset.name: CUPID
dataset.release_kind: public simulated interactions filtered by human annotators; not natural production logs

subset.sampling_seed: domain-separated SHA256 strings, not an integer PRNG seed
subset.sampling_algorithm: exclude 14 used development personas; sort by SHA256('cupid-feedback-learning-v1:'+persona), take 4; sort tasks by SHA256('learning-task:'+id)
subset.evaluation_granularity: one generated preference summary per task and arm; persona is the independent cluster

alignment.inference: selected task ID maps one-to-one to one adapted CUPID observation
alignment.baseline_injection: frozen injects only the task's user-message history
alignment.feedback_injection: feedback adds the same two bounded development examples as unlabelled plus controlled correction objects
alignment.labels: official preference/checklist opened only for post-generation semantic review; not memory-cause labels
alignment.memorycore_boundary: injected prompt fragments, not durable MemoryCore records; L0 native provenance was validated separately

execution.model: Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 local artifact; exact artifact revision was not recorded

metric_definitions.coverage: assistant semantic review full/partial/absent; not an official automatic grader
metric_definitions.paired_quality: task win/loss/tie, aggregated with persona as the independent cluster
metric_definitions.cluster_mean_utility: mean across personas of per-task outcome encoded win=1, tie=0, loss=-1
metric_definitions.cluster_bootstrap_95ci: R-7 interval from resampling persona means with replacement
metric_definitions.cluster_sign_test: two-sided exact sign test over non-zero persona-mean utilities
metric_definitions.input_tokens: tokenized prompt length including injected evidence
metric_definitions.generation_latency_ms: per-call model.generate wall time; excludes model load and data preparation
